scope: read-only counterfactual renormalising the 101-way assignment over the 100 groups (background mass = 0); no training, no checkpoint write
counterfactual_rule: A_cf[t,:100] = softmax(slot_logits[t,:100]); A_cf[t,bg] = 0; equivalent to A[t,q]/sum_j A[t,j]

assignment_equivalence.handling: the softmax over the 100 group logits is used for every token; it is equivalent to the conditional normalisation wherever the group mass is not degenerate
